sources.excerpt: BROKEN ARROW v2 – MIDI Overdrive Boost Pedal – Jackson Audio --> Skip to main content Search This Blog SAG Pro — High-End Studio Professional Audio SAG Pro focuses on high-end studio and professional audio equipment used in serious music, recording, and production environments. The platform covers studio systems, audio tools, and selected instruments with an emphasis on technical credibility, build quality, and professional workflows rather than mass-market gear. Home More… BROKEN ARROW v2 – MIDI Overdrive & Boost Pedal – Jackson Audio Get link Facebook X Pinterest Email Other Apps January 10, 2026 The BROKEN ARROW v2 represents a modern, modular approach to overdrive design, combining multiple gain structures, studio-grade EQ, and MIDI control into a single, performance-focused platform. Built for players who require flexibility without compromising tone, it merges classic overdrive behaviour with contemporary switching and preset recall. At its core, the BROKEN ARROW is a soft-clipping overdrive inspired by traditional TS-style circuits, but without a fixed mid-hump. Instead, it relies on an active 3-band EQ to shape the signal precisely. Four selectable clipping diode presets, level-matched internally, allow meaningful tonal changes without volume jumps. The unique GAIN CYCLE feature enables stepped gain increases on the fly, making dynamic live transitions possible without touching the controls. Complementing the drive section is an independent MOSFET boost circuit, derived from the PRISM Preamp. With four boost voicings and true bypass operation, it can be used either to push the overdrive or as a standalone clean boost. Full MIDI implementation allows remote control of drive, boost, clipping modes, gain stages, and boost EQ, making the pedal suitable for advanced pedalboards and MIDI-based rigs. Key features: • Comprehensive overdrive and boost platform • Four clipping diode presets with level matching • Innovative GAIN CYCLE for stepped gain control • Independent MOSFET boost circuit with four voicings • Studio-grade 3-band active EQ (Baxandall-based) • Full MIDI control via TRS connection • True bypass boost loop • Designed for live performance and studio use Controls: • Volume (master output) • Gain (maximum gain reference) • Bass / Mid / Treble (±12 dB active EQ) • Boost level MIDI functions (via Control Change): • Drive on/off • Boost on/off • Clipping diode selection • Gain Cycle stage selection • Boost EQ preset selection Technical specifications: Input impedance: 1 MΩ Output impedance: 100 kΩ Power: 9V DC (centre negative) Current draw: 150 mA (minimum) Dimensions: 2.7” × 4.875” Product link: https://jackson.audio/products/brokenarrow?ref=sagpro (affiliate link) Image credits: Jackson Audio Affiliate disclosure: This post may contain affiliate links.
